meta.name: incident-troubleshooting
meta.description: Use for incidents, outages, degradation, failed deployments, performance regressions, emergency diagnostics, stabilization, timelines, hypotheses, recovery plans, rollback, evidence capture, root cause notes, and prevention actions.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 定位线上故障根因,快速恢复服务
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你负责线上服务,遇到故障需要快速恢复。
copy.tagline_en: Diagnose outages, stabilize services, and capture lessons.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you handle live services and need a calm path through outages.

howto.what: 装了这个技能,Claude 遇到服务故障时会先控制影响,再调查原因。它会产出情况摘要、稳控步骤、假设清单、检查命令、恢复计划、预防措施、风险和假设,并整理出事件时间线。
howto.when: 用于事故、中断、性能回退等故障场景,以及恢复计划、回滚、根因分析等请求。

say.text: 系统刚发生中断,帮我先稳定服务并记录时间线。
say.note: Claude 会先做稳控并开始记录事件时间线。

say.text: 部署失败,请评估回滚方案并列出审批点。
say.note: Claude 会准备回滚计划并标明需要确认的步骤。

say.text: 服务性能下降,帮我排查根因并给出预防措施。
say.note: Claude 会引导假设验证并整理预防行动。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude first contains impact and then investigates when a service incident occurs. It produces a situation summary, stabilization steps, hypothesis list, check commands, recovery plan, prevention actions, risks and assumptions, and builds an incident timeline.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user describes an incident, outage, performance regression, or asks for recovery plans, rollback, or root cause analysis.

say_en.text: An incident just happened. Please stabilize the service and record the timeline.
say_en.note: Claude will stabilize first and start noting events.

say_en.text: Deployment failed. Please evaluate rollback options and list approval points.
say_en.note: Claude will prepare a rollback plan with confirmation steps.

say_en.text: Service performance dropped. Help me find root cause and propose prevention actions.
say_en.note: Claude will guide hypothesis checks and collect prevention steps.
